comparison.objective: Anchor a hand line at a road and extend it up both flanks of a grass fire.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-range line deployment and route coverage around a hazard.
comparison.success_condition: Line anchored at the road and run along both fire flanks; body provides no coverage, safety-distance, or deployment rubric.
comparison.reason: Route deployment and coverage do not test precision tool-in-insert alignment, hammer force regulation, notch fracture, or fragment containment.
